description: Split the monolithic main.py into a modular package structure with per-user SQLite database, encrypted token storage, proper state management, and fixed architectural issues. This is the foundation that all other features build upon.
steps: Create the bot/ package directory structure: bot/__init__.py, bot/config.py, bot/database.py, bot/state.py, bot/utils.py, bot/encryption.py
Create bot/config.py: Application-level constants (STOCKFISH_PATH, DB_PATH, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH, etc.) loaded from environment variables. No more global CONFIG_FILE.

Create bot/encryption.py: Token encryption using cryptography.fernet. Generate/load encryption key from environment variable BOT_ENCRYPTION_KEY or a local key file. Provide encrypt_token() and decrypt_token() functions.

Create bot/database.py: SQLite-based per-user storage. Schema: users table (chat_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, github_token TEXT encrypted, github_username TEXT, language TEXT DEFAULT 'ar', chess_depth INTEGER DEFAULT 14, created_at TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP). Functions: init_db(), save_user_config(chat_id, token, username), get_user_config(chat_id), delete_user_config(chat_id). Replace the old save_config/load_config that used a shared JSON file.

Create bot/state.py: A UserState class that replaces the global user_steps/awaiting_pgn/chess_wait_msg dicts. Use a single dict keyed by chat_id containing a dataclass/dict with fields: mode, current_repo, repo_map, wf_map, awaiting_pgn, chess_wait_msg_id, waiting_zip_msg, waiting_replace_msg, file_bytes, progress_msg_id. Provide get_state(chat_id), clear_state(chat_id), and preserve important fields (repo_map, wf_map, current_repo) on clear just like the original code does.

Create bot/utils.py: Move utility functions here - clean_txt(), send_long_message(), log_error(), get_github_client(chat_id) which loads user config from DB and returns a Github instance. Fix the error_logs to be per-instance with a max size deque.

Create bot/handlers/__init__.py, bot/handlers/menu.py, bot/handlers/setup.py, bot/handlers/github_repos.py, bot/handlers/github_files.py, bot/handlers/github_workflows.py, bot/handlers/chess_handler.py
bot/handlers/menu.py: Move show_main_menu, back_to_main, show_help_menu, show_bot_status, show_account_info handlers. Update to use database.get_user_config(chat_id) instead of load_config().

bot/handlers/setup.py: Move setup flow (start_setup, get_token_step, finish_setup). Update to use database.save_user_config() and encryption.encrypt_token(). Delete the user's message containing the token for security.

bot/handlers/github_repos.py: Move list_projects, repo_selected, create/delete/rename/settings handlers. Fix the callback_data collision: replace abs(hash(repo.name)) % 100000 with a proper approach - store repo names in state.repo_map keyed by index (sel_0, sel_1, sel_2...) instead of hash-based keys.
bot/handlers/github_files.py: Move browse_files, replace_file, ZIP upload handlers (do_handle_zip, extract_and_upload, finalize_create_repo, etc.).

bot/handlers/chess_handler.py: Move all chess-related functions (process_chess, generate_eval_graph, calculate_accuracy, etc.). Fix the double Stockfish analysis: currently generate_eval_graph runs engine.analyse in a loop AND process_chess runs another loop. Merge into a single pass that collects both evaluation scores for the graph AND move classifications simultaneously. Make chess depth configurable per user from database.

Fix bare 'except: pass' throughout all handlers - replace with 'except Exception as e: logger.warning(...)' or specific exception types. Key locations: delete_message calls (use a helper try_delete_message), the bare except in show_bot_status stockfish check, the bare excepts in account_info language loop.
Create new main.py entry point: Import bot instance, register all handlers by importing handler modules, setup Flask app, run polling. Keep it under 50 lines.
Update requirements.txt: Add cryptography, matplotlib (already used but not listed). Keep existing deps.
Update Dockerfile: No changes needed to Dockerfile since the structure change is internal.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open(f).read())"' succeeds for every .py file in bot/ and main.py
The bot/ package has proper __init__.py files and all imports resolve correctly when checked with 'python -c "import bot"' (assuming deps are installed)
No more global config.json - per-user SQLite storage in bot/database.py
Tokens are encrypted before storage using Fernet encryption
The callback_data collision risk from hash() is eliminated - using index-based keys
Chess analysis runs in a single Stockfish pass (no duplicate engine.analyse loops)
No bare 'except: pass' statements remain in the codebase
State management uses a centralized UserState approach instead of scattered global dicts
main.py is under 50 lines and simply wires everything together
verification: Run: find /projects/sandbox/M_bot -name '*.py' -exec python -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('{}').read())" \; to verify all files parse correctly
Run: python -c "import ast, os; [ast.parse(open(os.path.join(r,f)).read()) for r,d,fs in os.walk('/projects/sandbox/M_bot') for f in fs if f.endswith('.py')]" to verify no syntax errors
Run: grep -r 'except:' /projects/sandbox/M_bot/bot/ /projects/sandbox/M_bot/main.py to confirm no bare excepts remain
Run: grep -r 'abs(hash(' /projects/sandbox/M_bot/ to confirm hash collision risk is eliminated
Run: grep -r 'config.json' /projects/sandbox/M_bot/bot/ /projects/sandbox/M_bot/main.py to confirm no JSON config file usage remains
